verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships a documented AI Assistant users can chat with to plan, prioritize, and optimize their schedule (reclaim-docs-11), and a live hosted MCP endpoint backs this assistant feature (reclaim-probe-rt-1), confirming an actual delegatable AI agent rather than just automation rules. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports specifically describing conversational task delegation to the assistant (community evidence only covers scheduling automation, not the chat assistant itself), and more detail on the scope of tasks it can autonomously execute.
